reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Raff Arndt is the Chief Investment Officer of Australia's AUZ$145 billion Sovereign Wealth Fund, the Future Fund.
reader_summary.overview: Raff Arndt is the Chief Investment Officer of Australia's AUZ$145 billion Sovereign Wealth Fund, the Future Fund. He trained as an engineer and dove into infrastructure policy at the beginning of Australia's privatizations in the late 1990s. After investing in the space for six year, he joined the Future Fund in 2008 to head the infrastructure team.

key_points.text: Australia created the Future Fund only eleven years ago with a mandate to compound capital for 20 years before even contemplating withdrawals.
It has been described to me as a pool of capital with the size and transparency of CalPERS and the sophistication of Yale.
I'm sure you'll soon understand why.
